parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL3706. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
